dialogdefinitions.name: ac3select
dialogdefinitions.title: Audio Bitrate Selection
dialogdefinitions.description: Please select audio bitrate for AC3 encoding

dialogdefinitions.name: audiobitrate
dialogdefinitions.title: Audio Bitrate Selection
dialogdefinitions.description: Please select audio bitrate for lossy audio encoding

dialogdefinitions.name: audiostreamselect
dialogdefinitions.title: Audio Stream Selection
dialogdefinitions.description: Please select which audio stream to use for encoding

presets.name: alac
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossless ALAC format. If the input file is a video, the audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: flac
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossless FLAC format. If the input file is a video, the audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: wavpack
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossless WAVPACK format. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: cd-wav
presets.description: Encodes an input file to uncompressed PCM WAV format (CD quality). If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: dvd-wav
presets.description: Encodes an input file to uncompressed PCM WAV format (DVD quality). If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: mp3
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy MP3 format at 320kbps. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: m4a
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy AAC format at 192kbps. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: ac3
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy AC3 format at 448kbps. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: weba-opus-128k
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy Opus format at 128kbps. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: weba-opus-192k
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy Opus format at 192kbps. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: weba-vorbits
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy Vorbits format with variable bitrate quality 6. If the input file is a video, the audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: remux-mkv
presets.description: Remuxes an input video file to MKV container without re-encoding.

presets.name: h264-mp4
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to H.264 format in an MP4 container using Nvidia hardware acceleration.

presets.name: h265-mp4
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to H.265 format in an MP4 container using Nvidia hardware acceleration.

presets.name: ntsc-4:3-ac3
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to DVD compliant MPEG-2 format for NTSC 4:3 DVDs. Audio is encoded to AC3 format. Audo bitrate is selectable before encoding.

presets.name: ntsc-16:9-ac3
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to DVD compliant MPEG-2 format for NTSC 4:3 DVDs. Audio is encoded to AC3 format. Audo bitrate is selectable before encoding.

presets.name: pal-4:3-ac3
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to DVD compliant MPEG-2 format for PAL 4:3 DVDs. Audio is encoded to AC3 format. Audo bitrate is selectable before encoding.

presets.name: pal-16:9-ac3
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to DVD compliant MPEG-2 format for PAL 4:3 DVDs. Audio is encoded to AC3 format. Audo bitrate is selectable before encoding.
